_README: Ongoing story threads for cross-day memory. The cloud agent appends/updates threads each run and prunes stale ones. Format per thread: {"id", "title", "first_seen", "last_update", "summary", "status"}.

threads.title: US-Iran military escalation
threads.summary: Iran fired missiles at US forces in Jordan (intercepted); US and Saudi jets struck Iran-aligned targets in Iraq in response to prior drone attacks.

threads.title: Hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout
threads.summary: Google raised 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B; Microsoft/3M, SoftBank France (5GW/€75B), Chevron/Microsoft Texas power deal, and a possible Nvidia $250B OpenAI Ohio financing guarantee all point to accelerating AI data-center investment.

threads.title: Cisco SD-WAN active-exploitation campaign
threads.summary: State-aligned actor UAT-8616 has exploited seven Cisco SD-WAN zero-days in 2026 against government/critical-infrastructure targets; campaign remains active.

threads.title: France/Spain wildfires and heat wave
threads.summary: Wildfires have displaced roughly 330,000 people across France and Spain, the largest peacetime evacuation in French history; a new heat spike is forecast.

threads.title: Japan (Kumamoto) earthquake recovery
threads.summary: Magnitude-7.1 quake near Kumamoto has killed 18; rescue operations continue at a collapsed shopping mall.
